# `perf` commands

## `perf bench`

Time the fixed scenario set (everyday reads and writes, the 1,000-row deposit and reconciliation, the organisation-wide membership grant) on a copy of a template, and store the run under a name. Local operator tool.

| Contract | Value |
|---|---|
| Scope | hub |
| Kind | read |
| Required role | none |
| Capability | none |
| Feature | — |
| HTTP | Local only; no HTTP route. |
| External binary body | none |

### CLI

`bookflow perf bench --template /srv/bench/bench-large-s180-co0088 --name before --json`

### Input

| JSON field | CLI input | Type | Required | Nullable | Default | Description and constraints |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `template` | `--template` | string | yes | no | — | A template folder from `perf generate`; the bench works on a copy; minimum length 1 |
| `name` | `--name` | string | yes | no | — | Name to store the run under; minimum length 1; maximum length 80; pattern "^[A-Za-z0-9._-]+$" |
| `repeat` | `--repeat` | integer | no | no | 5 | Timed repetitions per scenario (some heavy ones run fewer); minimum 1; maximum 50 |
| `only` | `--only` | array[string] | no | no | [] | Run only these scenarios (by name or command) |
| `store` | `--store` | string \| null | no | yes | null | Directory for stored runs; defaults to <data root>/telemetry/bench |
| `work_dir` | `--work-dir` | string \| null | no | yes | null | Where the working copy goes; defaults to the system temporary directory |

### Command and context options

| Option | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--json` | Print one JSON object. |

### HTTP

This command has no HTTP route.

### Output

| JSON field | Type | Required | Nullable | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | yes | no | — | — |
| `path` | string | yes | no | — | — |
| `seconds` | number | yes | no | — | — |
| `items` | array[object] | yes | no | — | — |
| `items[].scenario` | string | yes | no | — | — |
| `items[].group` | string | yes | no | — | — |
| `items[].command` | string | yes | no | — | — |
| `items[].reps` | integer | yes | no | — | — |
| `items[].p50_ms` | number | yes | no | — | — |
| `items[].p95_ms` | number | yes | no | — | — |
| `items[].max_ms` | number | yes | no | — | — |
| `items[].sql_count` | integer \| null | yes | yes | — | — |
| `items[].rows` | integer \| null | yes | yes | — | — |

Example JSON output:

```json
{
  "items": [],
  "name": "value",
  "path": "/example",
  "seconds": 1.0
}
```

### Errors

| Code | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `E_CONTEXT_IN_INPUT` | Input contains a context field. |
| `E_INTERNAL` | Internal failure. |
| `E_IO` | A filesystem operation failed. |
| `E_USAGE` | Invalid command syntax. |
| `E_VALIDATION` | Invalid input. |

## `perf compare`

Compare a stored bench run with a baseline and flag scenarios that got slower beyond a threshold. Local operator tool.

| Contract | Value |
|---|---|
| Scope | hub |
| Kind | read |
| Required role | none |
| Capability | none |
| Feature | — |
| HTTP | Local only; no HTTP route. |
| External binary body | none |

### CLI

`bookflow perf compare --run after --baseline before --threshold 25 --json`

### Input

| JSON field | CLI input | Type | Required | Nullable | Default | Description and constraints |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `run` | `--run` | string | yes | no | — | A stored run's name, or a run file; minimum length 1 |
| `baseline` | `--baseline` | string | yes | no | — | The baseline run's name, or a run file; minimum length 1 |
| `threshold` | `--threshold` | number | no | no | 25.0 | Flag a scenario whose p50 is slower by more than this percent; greater than 0; maximum 1000 |
| `floor_ms` | `--floor-ms` | number | no | no | 20.0 | and by more than this many milliseconds; minimum 0 |
| `store` | `--store` | string \| null | no | yes | null | Directory of stored runs; defaults to <data root>/telemetry/bench |

### Command and context options

| Option | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--json` | Print one JSON object. |

### HTTP

This command has no HTTP route.

### Output

| JSON field | Type | Required | Nullable | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `run` | string | yes | no | — | — |
| `baseline` | string | yes | no | — | — |
| `run_load_1m` | number \| null | no | yes | null | Load average when the run was taken; compare wall times only under similar load |
| `baseline_load_1m` | number \| null | no | yes | null | — |
| `threshold_pct` | number | yes | no | — | — |
| `floor_ms` | number | yes | no | — | — |
| `regressions` | integer | yes | no | — | — |
| `items` | array[object] | yes | no | — | — |
| `items[].scenario` | string | yes | no | — | — |
| `items[].baseline_p50_ms` | number | yes | no | — | — |
| `items[].run_p50_ms` | number | yes | no | — | — |
| `items[].change_ms` | number | yes | no | — | — |
| `items[].change_pct` | number \| null | yes | yes | — | — |
| `items[].baseline_sql` | integer \| null | yes | yes | — | — |
| `items[].run_sql` | integer \| null | yes | yes | — | — |
| `items[].regression` | boolean | yes | no | — | — |
| `items[].improvement` | boolean | yes | no | — | — |

Example JSON output:

```json
{
  "baseline": "value",
  "baseline_load_1m": null,
  "floor_ms": 1.0,
  "items": [],
  "regressions": 1,
  "run": "value",
  "run_load_1m": null,
  "threshold_pct": 1.0
}
```

### Errors

| Code | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `E_CONTEXT_IN_INPUT` | Input contains a context field. |
| `E_INTERNAL` | Internal failure. |
| `E_IO` | A filesystem operation failed. |
| `E_USAGE` | Invalid command syntax. |
| `E_VALIDATION` | Invalid input. |

## `perf generate`

Build the large bench company (five years of demo-style history posted through the ordinary commands) as a reusable template. Local operator tool: it never opens your books.

| Contract | Value |
|---|---|
| Scope | hub |
| Kind | read |
| Required role | none |
| Capability | none |
| Feature | — |
| HTTP | Local only; no HTTP route. |
| External binary body | none |

### CLI

`bookflow perf generate --output /srv/bench --profile large --json`

### Input

| JSON field | CLI input | Type | Required | Nullable | Default | Description and constraints |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `output` | `--output` | string | yes | no | — | Directory to hold templates; the template is a new folder in it; minimum length 1 |
| `profile` | `--profile` | literal["large", "small", "tiny"] | no | no | "large" | large: 5 years, ~18,000 documents; small: a tenth; tiny: seconds, for tests |
| `seed` | `--seed` | integer | no | no | 180 | Random seed; the same seed and profile post the same history; minimum 0 |

### Command and context options

| Option | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--json` | Print one JSON object. |

### HTTP

This command has no HTTP route.

### Output

| JSON field | Type | Required | Nullable | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `template` | string | yes | no | — | — |
| `reused` | boolean | yes | no | — | A template with this profile, seed and schema already existed |
| `generation_seconds` | number | yes | no | — | — |
| `disk_bytes` | integer | yes | no | — | — |
| `counts` | object[string, integer] | yes | no | — | — |

Example JSON output:

```json
{
  "counts": {},
  "disk_bytes": 1,
  "generation_seconds": 1.0,
  "reused": false,
  "template": "value"
}
```

### Errors

| Code | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `E_CONTEXT_IN_INPUT` | Input contains a context field. |
| `E_INTERNAL` | Internal failure. |
| `E_IO` | A filesystem operation failed. |
| `E_USAGE` | Invalid command syntax. |
| `E_VALIDATION` | Invalid input. |

## `perf report`

Report how long commands take: p50, p95 and max per command and surface over a window, and the slowest single calls. Times are inside the command (validation through the response), with SQL statement counts. Nothing about the books' content is recorded.

| Contract | Value |
|---|---|
| Scope | hub |
| Kind | read |
| Required role | any signed-in person or agent; installation administrators see every company, others only calls on companies they can see |
| Capability | hub |
| Feature | — |
| HTTP | `POST /commands/perf.report` |
| External binary body | none |

### CLI

`bookflow perf report --since 7d --surface http --json`

### MCP

The same example as complete `bookflow_run` arguments:

```json
{"command": "perf report", "input": {"since": "7d", "surface": "http"}}
```

### Input

| JSON field | CLI input | Type | Required | Nullable | Default | Description and constraints |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `since` | `--since` | string | no | no | "7d" | Window start: a date, a date and time (UTC unless given), or 24h / 7d; maximum length 40 |
| `command` | `--command` | string \| null | no | yes | null | Only this command, e.g. `invoice post` |
| `surface` | `--surface` | literal["cli", "python", "http", "mcp", "workbench", "system"] \| null | no | yes | null | Only calls through this surface |
| `limit` | `--limit` | integer | no | no | 50 | Most commands to list, slowest p95 first; minimum 1; maximum 500 |
| `slowest` | `--slowest` | integer | no | no | 10 | How many of the slowest single calls to list; minimum 0; maximum 100 |

### Command and context options

| Option | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--json` | Print one JSON object. |
| `--data-root TEXT` | Data root; otherwise `BOOKFLOW_DATA_ROOT`, then `~/.bookflow`. |

### HTTP

Route: `POST /commands/perf.report`

Send the input object as JSON. Authentication may instead come from a browser session cookie.

| Header | Requirement | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `Authorization` | required for bearer clients | `Bearer <secret>` |
| `X-Bookflow-Client-Name` | optional | Stable caller name recorded in audit |
| `X-Bookflow-Client-Version` | optional | Caller version recorded in audit |
| `X-Bookflow-Context-Encoding` | optional | percent-utf8: encode all reason, source-ref, directive, idempotency-key, client-name and client-version header values as UTF-8 percent encoding |

### Output

| JSON field | Type | Required | Nullable | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `since` | string | yes | no | — | Window start, UTC |
| `scope` | literal["installation", "visible companies"] | yes | no | — | — |
| `recording` | boolean | yes | no | — | — |
| `calls` | integer | yes | no | — | — |
| `items` | array[object] | yes | no | — | — |
| `items[].command` | string | yes | no | — | — |
| `items[].surface` | string | yes | no | — | — |
| `items[].count` | integer | yes | no | — | — |
| `items[].errors` | integer | yes | no | — | — |
| `items[].p50_ms` | number | yes | no | — | — |
| `items[].p95_ms` | number | yes | no | — | — |
| `items[].max_ms` | number | yes | no | — | — |
| `items[].total_ms` | number | yes | no | — | — |
| `items[].mean_sql` | number | yes | no | — | Mean SQL statements per call |
| `items[].max_rows` | integer | yes | no | — | Longest list a call took in or gave back (lines, sources, items) |
| `slowest` | array[object] | yes | no | — | — |
| `slowest[].at` | string | yes | no | — | — |
| `slowest[].command` | string | yes | no | — | — |
| `slowest[].surface` | string | yes | no | — | — |
| `slowest[].principal` | string | yes | no | — | — |
| `slowest[].outcome` | string | yes | no | — | — |
| `slowest[].wall_ms` | number | yes | no | — | — |
| `slowest[].sql_count` | integer | yes | no | — | — |
| `slowest[].sql_ms` | number | yes | no | — | — |
| `slowest[].rows_in` | integer \| null | yes | yes | — | — |
| `slowest[].rows_out` | integer \| null | yes | yes | — | — |
| `slowest[].size_class` | string \| null | yes | yes | — | Company database size bucket |

Example JSON output:

```json
{
  "calls": 1,
  "items": [],
  "recording": false,
  "scope": "installation",
  "since": "2026-01-01T00:00:00Z",
  "slowest": []
}
```

### Errors

| Code | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `E_COMPANY_AMBIGUOUS` | More than one company matches; use the id or Organization/Company. |
| `E_COMPANY_NOT_FOUND` | No such company. |
| `E_CONFIG_INVALID` | The configuration file could not be read. |
| `E_CONTEXT_IN_INPUT` | Input contains a context field. |
| `E_DB_BUSY` | Another Bookflow command is running on this data root. |
| `E_FEATURE_DISABLED` | This feature is not enabled for the company. |
| `E_FS_UNKNOWN` | The filesystem type of the path could not be determined. |
| `E_INTERNAL` | Internal failure. |
| `E_IO` | A filesystem operation failed. |
| `E_MIGRATION_FAILED` | A schema migration failed; the database was backed up first and is unchanged. |
| `E_NETWORK_SHARE` | The path is on a network filesystem, which Bookflow refuses to use. |
| `E_NOT_INITIALIZED` | The data root is not initialized; run `bookflow init`. |
| `E_NO_ACTOR` | This login is not mapped to a Bookflow user. |
| `E_ORGANIZATION_NOT_FOUND` | No such organization. |
| `E_PARTIAL_WRITE` | The authoritative write committed, but a secondary update remains incomplete. |
| `E_PERMISSION` | The acting user may not run this command here. |
| `E_REASON_REQUIRED` | This write needs a reason: a short phrase naming what triggered it (--reason on the CLI, a top-level reason on MCP, the X-Bookflow-Reason header on HTTP). |
| `E_SCHEMA_BEHIND` | The database schema is behind this version of Bookflow; run `bookflow upgrade`. |
| `E_SCHEMA_UNKNOWN` | The database schema revision is not known to this version of Bookflow; upgrade Bookflow. |
| `E_UNAUTHENTICATED` | No valid credential: log in, or send a bearer token. |
| `E_USAGE` | Invalid command syntax. |
| `E_VALIDATION` | Invalid input. |

## `perf settings`

Show the timings store (size, rows, retention) or turn recording on or off. The store is telemetry kept beside the hub, never in the books; turning it off stops new rows within two seconds and keeps what is recorded.

| Contract | Value |
|---|---|
| Scope | hub |
| Kind | read |
| Required role | hub_admin |
| Capability | company |
| Feature | — |
| HTTP | `POST /commands/perf.settings` |
| External binary body | none |

### CLI

`bookflow perf settings --recording off --json`

### MCP

The same example as complete `bookflow_run` arguments:

```json
{"command": "perf settings", "input": {"recording": "off"}}
```

### Input

| JSON field | CLI input | Type | Required | Nullable | Default | Description and constraints |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `recording` | `--recording` | literal["on", "off"] \| null | no | yes | null | Turn recording on or off; omit to show the settings |

### Command and context options

| Option | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--json` | Print one JSON object. |
| `--data-root TEXT` | Data root; otherwise `BOOKFLOW_DATA_ROOT`, then `~/.bookflow`. |

### HTTP

Route: `POST /commands/perf.settings`

Send the input object as JSON. Authentication may instead come from a browser session cookie.

| Header | Requirement | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `Authorization` | required for bearer clients | `Bearer <secret>` |
| `X-Bookflow-Client-Name` | optional | Stable caller name recorded in audit |
| `X-Bookflow-Client-Version` | optional | Caller version recorded in audit |
| `X-Bookflow-Context-Encoding` | optional | percent-utf8: encode all reason, source-ref, directive, idempotency-key, client-name and client-version header values as UTF-8 percent encoding |

### Output

| JSON field | Type | Required | Nullable | Default | Description |

| `recording` | boolean | yes | no | — | — |
| `environment_off` | boolean | yes | no | — | BOOKFLOW_PERF=off is set for this process |
| `path` | string | yes | no | — | — |
| `bytes` | integer | yes | no | — | Store size on disk, with its write-ahead log |
| `raw_rows` | integer | yes | no | — | — |

| `raw_cap` | integer | yes | no | — | and at most this many rows |

Example JSON output:
